verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community quote of Morph's privacy policy. It says Free Tier code may be used for training, while the Enterprise Tier uses submitted code only to process the immediate request. That suggests retention posture can be controlled only by choosing a plan, and the commenter found the policy unclear. missing for 10: first-party docs on retention periods, user-facing deletion controls or a deletion API, per-request or org-level zero-retention settings, training opt-out outside Enterprise, independent verification.
